schema: Seven columns [CNF,XOR,SEP,FUS,Gamma,Interface,Machine]; signed exact integer deltas are rational denominators one
model: Repeatable disjoint-width FUSE in singleton-batch preauthenticated record calculus
ruleClasses: VIEW,NOP cost0; BAD_REQUEST cost1; CHECK(g) cost1; BATCH(j) cost1; FUSE_b(K,j) cost1 with all b distinct unpaid identities and unpaid j; HALT cost1 when finished
